ethos.e: 拉丁语, 源自 希腊语 Ethic.

k: 生态学的，主张生态保护的

etiology.e: 拉丁语 aetologia, 希腊语 a'itiologi`a; a'iti`a cause + lo`gos description: 参见 法语 étiologie.
r: study of, science of; written work; structure or principle

etiquette.e: 法语 prop., a little piece of paper, or a mark or title, affixed to a bag or bundle, expressing its contents, a label, ticket, OF.estiquete, of German origin; 参见 LG. stikke peg, pin, tack, stikken to stick, 德语 stecken. 见 Stick, and 参见 Ticket.

k: 乌托邦的，空想社会主义的

etymological.e: 拉丁语 etymologicus, 希腊语 'etymologiko`s: 参见 法语 étymologique. 见 Etymology.

etymology.e: L.etymologia, 希腊语 'etymologi`a; 'e`tymon etymon + lo`gos discourse, description: 参见 法语 étymologie. 见 Etymon, and -logy.
r: study of, science of; written work; structure or principle

eucalyptus.e: 新拉丁语, from 希腊语 e'y^ well, good + <?/ covered. The buds of Eucalyptus have a hemispherical or conical covering, which falls off at anthesis.

eucharist.e: 拉丁语 eucharistia, 希腊语 e'ycharisti`a, lit., a giving of thanks; e'y^ + cha`ris favor, grace, thanks; 同源于 chai`rein to rejoice, and 可能 to yearn: 参见 法语 eucharistie.
s: 礼拜仪式，祷告文，圣餐仪式

r: science, study, or practice of; properties of; practices pertaining to

eulogy.e: 希腊语 e'y^ well + Eulogium, and see Legend.
r: study of, science of; written work; structure or principle

eunuch.e: 拉丁语 eunuchus, 希腊语 <?/, prop., keeping or guarding the couch; <?/ couch, bed, + <?/ to have, hold, keep.

euphemism.e: 希腊语 e'y^ well + euphémisme. 见 Fame.
r: act, process, state, practice, or instance of

s: 像银的，银色的，银铃一般的

euphony.e: 拉丁语 euphonia, 希腊语 e'y^ well + euphonie.

euphorbia.e: 新拉丁语, 源自 拉丁语 euphorbea. 见 Euphorrium.

s: 扩张性的，使扩大的，广阔的

eureka.e: 希腊语 <?/ I have found, perfect indicative of <?/ to find.

k: 曙光，极光，奥罗拉(曙光女神)
